resolved_preflight_findings: Base roof/clamp overhangs and integral skirt bumps require generated support. Final base/lower-ring checks use normal(auto); upper ring uses tree(auto).

Automatic placement on the combined350mm H2D bed can clip brims. Final base/lower-ring checks turn the300mm side along printerY, disable further arranging rotations, and retain the unchanged manufacturer machine profile. Full deposition bounds fit both single-nozzle areas.
Native3MF re-import and reduced arranging-area trials failed and were excluded. Only passing final direct-STL slices are included.

A trial Zrotation moved the base partly below the build plate. That result and its low mass estimate were rejected. The final command includes --ensure-on-bed; original triangle counts, rigid transforms, Z0 placement and complete printed heights are verified for all ten designs.

observed_console_diagnostics.scope: These commands appear in the unchanged installed manufacturer H2D machine start/end G-code. Bambu returned process0/result0 and an empty plate warning_message; no printer execution was performed.

limitations: This is software acceptance and real H2D G-code generation; it is not a physical test.
No structural load rating, impact resistance, screw retention, dimensional fit, motor temperature or battery runtime has been physically verified.
Brims and any generated support are included in checked deposition bounds. Machine cleaning/purge motions are excluded because they are printer-specific movements outside model footprints.
G-code, full temporary profiles and sliced 3MF remain outside the repository. No printer was connected, uploaded to or commanded to print.
Installed user profiles, authentication state and existing Bambu Studio sessions were not read or changed.
